summary: Turkmenistan's State Migration Service says foreign citizens may enter and stay on the basis of a visa unless an international treaty of Turkmenistan provides otherwise. The UK and Canadian governments say a visa application needs a letter of invitation; the UK Foreign Office says authorised travel agents provide these for tourist visits, and that with the letter you apply at an Embassy of Turkmenistan or buy a visa on arrival at Ashgabat airport and some land borders.

fee.notes: Paid on arrival. The UK Foreign Office says a tourism tax of USD 2 per day of stay is charged separately and that hotels include it as a separate item on the bill. It also says to bring US dollars in cash for any other charges at entry.

declarations.text: The UK Foreign Office says you pay a USD 14 migration fee on arrival and that all foreign visitors pay a tourism tax of USD 2 for each day of their stay. It says stays of more than 3 working days must be registered with the State Migration Service within 3 days of arrival, and that your hotel or sponsor usually does this.

currencyLimits.text: Foreign cash may be brought in without limit if it is declared to customs. On departure you may take out up to USD 10,000 (or the equivalent), plus any foreign currency you brought in and declared, on presenting your import declaration.

source.name: State Customs Service of Turkmenistan — For individuals: import and export of foreign currency

notes: The UK FCDO says you may bring prescription medicines with a copy of the prescription, but you could be prosecuted for carrying drugs Turkmenistan classifies as narcotics, such as morphine or strong painkillers, without a prescription or in more than you need without declaring them.
The UK FCDO says the tobacco allowance is 2 packs: for example 2 packets of cigarettes (40 cigarettes) or 2 cigars.

payments.text: The UK FCDO says Turkmenistan is largely cash-based: pay in manat, bring new, clean US dollar or euro notes to exchange at banks, and bring enough dollars for your whole trip, as the few international ATMs in Ashgabat can run out of cash. The Government of Canada says only a few hotels and restaurants in Ashgabat accept credit cards.

safety.text: The UK Foreign Office says the crime rate is low but to take the same care as you would in the UK, that land border crossings can close without notice, that access to areas near the borders with Afghanistan and Iran is tightly restricted, and that although Turkmenistan has no recent history of terrorism, attacks cannot be ruled out.

tips.text: The UK Foreign Office says visa applications made at an Embassy of Turkmenistan are referred to Ashgabat for a decision, which can take up to a month, and that a letter of invitation for a transit visa can also take up to a month to issue.

The Government of Canada says photographing military installations, police stations, airports, government buildings and other sensitive sites may result in a penalty, and advises seeking permission from local authorities before taking photographs.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Turkmenistan?
faq.answer: Turkmenistan's State Migration Service says foreign citizens enter on the basis of a visa unless an international treaty of Turkmenistan provides otherwise. The UK and Canadian governments say a visa application needs a letter of invitation; for tourist visits, the UK Foreign Office says authorised travel agents provide these letters.

faq.question: How do I get a Turkmenistan letter of invitation?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says the letter comes from the person you will visit, the company you will work for or an authorised travel agency in Turkmenistan, which submits the request to the State Migration Service. With the letter, the UK Foreign Office says, you can apply at an Embassy of Turkmenistan, where the decision is referred to Ashgabat and can take up to a month, or buy a visa on arrival at Ashgabat International Airport and some land borders.

faq.question: Can I get a Turkmenistan visa on arrival?
faq.answer: Yes, once you have your letter of invitation: the UK Foreign Office says the visa on arrival is available at Ashgabat International Airport and some land borders. The State Migration Service adds USD 50 to the fee for a visa obtained at the international airport.

faq.question: Is there a Turkmenistan transit visa without an invitation letter?
faq.answer: No. The transit visa is for up to 5 days per trip. The UK Foreign Office says it also needs a letter of invitation sponsored by the State Migration Service, that you must enter and leave through the border crossings named on it, that it is most commonly used for entry through a land border, for example overland from Uzbekistan, and that it cannot be bought at Baku seaport.

faq.question: Can I travel independently in Turkmenistan?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states whether tourists must be accompanied by a guide. Canada's travel advice says the areas bordering Iran, Uzbekistan and Afghanistan, including the city of Dashoguz and areas of the Caspian coast, are restricted zones that need government permission, applied for at least 10 working days ahead. The UK Foreign Office says transit-visa holders must enter and leave through the border crossings named on their letter of invitation.
